 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-aa0ec757.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The repeated full-color rows delimit the framed template panels.
    frame = grid[0][0]
    left_w = 0
    for v in grid[0]:
        if v != frame:
            break
        left_w += 1
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(left_w))]
    panels = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(separators, separators[1:]) if b > a + 1]

    # Extract each colored object on the right as a normalized binary silhouette.
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, frame)})
    shapes = {}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(left_w, w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
        shapes[color] = (r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, frozenset((r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells))

    out = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]
    for a, b in panels:
        mask = [(r, c) for r in range(a, b) for c in range(1, left_w-1) if grid[r][c] == 0]
        if not mask:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in mask), max(r for r, _ in mask)
        c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in mask), max(c for _, c in mask)
        target = (r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, frozenset((r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in mask))
        color = next((col for col, shape in shapes.items() if shape == target), None)
        if color is not None:
            for r, c in mask:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import json, sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.loads(sys.stdin.read()))))
